description: Undirected weighted simple graph of gap junction (electrical) connections in the adult hermaphrodite C. elegans. Bidirectional edges merged into single undirected edges with weight = total gap junction count. Contains 3 self-loops (autaptic gap junctions). Data from White et al. 1986 via WormAtlas.
name: C. elegans Hermaphrodite Gap Junction Connectome
